inspection.reviewer: Delegated assistant after viewing original, decoded light/dark/checkerboard export, contact/interior details and both sizes across all eight current containers; independent UX reviewer inspected original contacts/anatomy

checks.name: identity
checks.observation: Viewed original and decoded runtime: one adult in a frontal standing cable face-pull position, elbows bent outward around shoulder height, hands in front of the cheeks and feet planted apart.

checks.name: style-consistency
checks.observation: Compared with the actual previously inspected unchanged approved front-plank master: same muted blue-gray top, terracotta leggings, bun, natural adult proportions and softly shaded educational finish. Shoes and tower are unbranded gray.

checks.name: pose-and-contact-readability
checks.observation: Both full arms and hands, two complete legs/shoes, upright trunk and a planted stance remain visible. Each hand visibly wraps a separate rubber-ended rope branch. No obvious duplicated limb or disconnected body joint observed.

checks.name: equipment-continuity
checks.observation: Two separate rope branches visibly join the single central ring and reach their respective gripping hands in open space below the mouth. Diagonal cable is traceable from the high pulley to that connector. Tower cap, rods, stack and base read as continuous. Independent original-source review agrees the branch/contact issue is resolved; no mechanical certification is claimed.

checks.name: alpha-and-decoded-edges
checks.observation: Viewed original/decoded light and dark composites, checkerboard and tower-interior crop. Gaps around the guide rods are clean transparency with continuous rod edges. Apparent mottled white/red areas in raw transparency display do not appear in actual compositing. No distracting rectangular matte or colored fringe observed.

checks.name: small-usage-and-containment
checks.observation: Viewed source/runtime helper panels at 256x144 and 320x180 and all eight current container-color composites at both sizes. Person, both gripping hands, rope/connector arrangement and complete tower remain recognizable. No head, shoe, cap or base is visibly clipped. The thin diagonal cable is less distinct on dark surfaces at small size. Upper breathing room remains tight and the prompt6% margin aim is not met; this pass covers containment/readability only, not that margin aim.

checks.name: interface-remnants
checks.observation: No text, weight numbers, labels, arrows, gym/scenery, app controls, phone frame, branding or watermark observed.

limitations: Prompt aims for6% margins; actual visible alpha>=128 bbox is [294,10,1210,909] on1672x941: top10px (~1.1%,1.9dp at180), bottom32px (~3.4%,6.1dp). This target is unmet; full cap and shoes are contained. Present this tight-margin caveat for owner review rather than claiming generous margins.
Fine cable/connector detail is clearer in an enlarged view; diagonal cable contrast is naturally lower on dark small previews.
Visual pose and equipment plausibility do not clinically validate technique or mechanically certify the station.
Untagged pixels are explicitly interpreted as sRGB under the profile; no embedded sRGB measurement or color conversion claimed.
Deterministic boards use current presentation.json colors; they do not establish actual RN/native rendering, text/control contrast or signed-phone acceptance.
